description: Add parentSessionId and spawnedChildren fields to the Session Metadata contract (app schema + CLI type mirror), a shared sync.ts normalizer, and storage helpers (getSessionParent, getSessionChildren). Read-side parity only — UI and CLI write-flow are deferred. Single commit on main.

planReviewContext.description: The applySessions 'preserve spawnedChildren: undefined' merge block is wrong. Metadata is server-authoritative; preserving stale local spawnedChildren when server sends undefined would resurrect removed parent-child relationships and mask producer writes. The simpler correct approach: extend schema, normalize IDs on ingress, let metadata round-trip as-is. No special applySessions logic needed because there is no schema default that backfills [].
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Do NOT add a preserve-undefined branch to applySessions. The schema uses .optional() (no default), so applySessions full-replace passes undefined through naturally. Acceptance criterion verifies field is undefined/absent after a server update without spawnedChildren — not that a stale local value persists.

planReviewContext.description: Plan defers CLI fork/spawn writer wiring (createSessionMetadata.ts, runCodex.ts, daemon/forkSession.ts HAPPY_FORKED_FROM_SESSION_ID, ops.ts machineForkSession). Without these, real user flows will not populate the new fields. Acknowledged as out-of-scope for this task; tracked as a separate spawn-flow follow-up in plans/parallel-assignments.md.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Do NOT attempt to wire CLI write surfaces in this commit. The follow-up task name in Open Questions #1 is 'session-parent-link-writer' (or similar).

planReviewContext.description: No acceptance criterion tests a real fork flow producing parentSessionId on a child session. Acknowledged — read-side parity verifies the contract independent of who writes the field; the spawn-flow task will own end-to-end fork verification.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Round-trip AC (Session built with both fields → applySessions → store read → simulated re-fetch → applySessions → fields unchanged) is sufficient for this commit's read-side scope.
